  Problem Solving Using Computers [CSE-1071]

  A  
Answer all the questions.

  computer system.

2B)           (i) Write a C program that reads integers until the user enters -1. When the user stops             (5)  
  entering numbers, display the largest of all the numbers entered. [1-syntax,1.5-logic]  
  (ii) Write a C program to calculate parking charges of a vehicle using switch case  
  statement. Enter the type of vehicle as a character ('c' for car, 'b' for bus, 't' for truck, 's'

for scooty, 'y' for cycle and 'm' for motorcycle) and number of parking hours. Then  
  calculate the parking charges as per the given rates:  
  (a) Bus-20 Rs/hr  
  (b) Car-10 Rs/hr  
  (c) Truck-30 Rs/hr  
  (d) Scooty- 5 Rs/hr  
  (e) Cycle-15 Rs/hr  
  (f) Motorcycle-20 Rs/hr  
  (2+3 = 5 marks)

  $$i) a+= b -= c*=10                                                                           (2)$$

3A)             Draw the flowchart for binary search technique. Consider the following 1D array arr[] =  
  {64, 25, 12, 22, 11} and illustrate the working of selection sort algorithm.            (3)  
  
3B)             Write a C program to remove special characters and digits leaving the alphabets  
  unaltered in a given string.  
  Sample I/O                                                                                  (3)  
  Input the string 22india;  
  Output String: india  
  
3C)             Write the different ways of initialization of a 2D array. Write a C program to read 2D  
  array and find the count of duplicate elements in each row of the matrix. Display the       (4)  
  count of duplicate elements row wise.  
  
4A)             Write a C program to check the given number is perfect or not using functions. Analyse  
  the pros and cons of iteration and recursive functions.                                (3)  
  
4B)             Write a C program to print a string after replacing all the occurrences of the given  
  character. This must be implemented using "call by reference" concept. Define and use a  
  function replace() that must accept a character pointer, the character to replace, and the (3)  
  i)        replacement character.  
  
  ii)       Write a program to get a three (3) digit positive number from the user. Pass this number  
  to a function is Prime() that checks if the sum of the digits of the number is a prime or (2)  
  not. Print appropriate message from the main function.  
  
4C)             Explain recursion. Write a program in C to print first 50 natural numbers using  
  recursion.                                                                                  (2)  
  
5A)             Write a C Program to reverse the string using pointer and display the output string after  
  reversing the characters. Do not use string handling functions.                             (3)  
  
5B)             Explain six classifications of cybercrime where computers become the target of crime.  
  (3)  
  
5C)             Write a C program to Create a structure 'contacts' that reads the contact details of  
  students with Hostel_No, Block_Name, and location_name as members. Create  
  another structure 'student' with name, department, fees, and contacts (structure) as its (4)  
  members. Using an array of structures, read the details of 15 students. Read a location  
  name from the user and display the name of the students who belong to that location.
